_README: MARKER-ONLY (CLAUDE.md §5). Fetched lazily only when a teacher/marker PDF is generated. English-only. Client-side best-effort separation, not real security.

markingScheme.criterion: Quotes at least two genuine Life-Scanner results from their own Investigation Record, covering the flame and/or the virus (e.g. the number of real life processes and look-alikes, or named processes that were detected / not detected).
markingScheme.accept: Any two specific results that match the student's own Life-scanner rows, e.g. 'the flame showed 0 real life processes and 5 look-alikes', 'the virus showed reproduction only as a look-alike', 'the flame had no sensitivity or control'. Exact wording not required.
markingScheme.insufficient: A general statement ('they showed some signs') with no actual result quoted, or results that do not appear in the student's record.

markingScheme.criterion: Flame: explains that it only shows look-alikes / some signs, not all eight real life processes (names at least one process it lacks, e.g. reproduction, sensitivity, control), and links this to the rule that a living organism must carry out ALL eight characteristics (MRS C GREN).
markingScheme.accept: 'Burning is not respiration because it does not happen inside cells'; 'it is not made of cells'; 'it cannot reproduce or respond to stimuli, and living things do all 8'.
markingScheme.insufficient: 'A flame is not alive' or 'it is just fire' with no reference to the missing characteristics or to the all-eight rule.

markingScheme.criterion: Virus: explains that it can only reproduce inside a host cell and does not carry out the other life processes by itself (e.g. no respiration, nutrition, growth, excretion) and/or is not made of cells.
markingScheme.accept: 'It needs a host cell to make copies'; 'it is only DNA/RNA in a protein coat, not a cell'; 'it does not feed, respire or grow'.
markingScheme.insufficient: 'Viruses cause disease' or 'viruses are very small' — neither explains why it is not living.

markingScheme.criterion: Names the kingdom as fungi (a mould).
markingScheme.accept: 'Fungus', 'fungi', 'it is a mould (fungus)'. Naming Penicillium as a fungus is also fine.
markingScheme.insufficient: 'Bacteria', 'protoctist', 'plant', or 'mould' with no indication that a mould is a fungus.

markingScheme.criterion: Gives one structural feature that shows it is a fungus: the threads are hyphae forming a mycelium, OR cell walls made of chitin, OR hyphae containing many nuclei.
markingScheme.accept: 'Network of hyphae (mycelium)'; 'thread-like hyphae'; 'chitin cell walls'; 'many nuclei in the threads'.
markingScheme.insufficient: 'It is fuzzy' or 'it is blue-green' — colour/texture alone is not a structural feature of the kingdom.

markingScheme.criterion: Explains saprophytic nutrition: the fungus releases (secretes) enzymes onto the orange, which digest it outside the fungus (extracellular digestion), and the fungus then absorbs the soluble products.
markingScheme.accept: 'Saprophytic/saprotrophic nutrition — enzymes digest the orange outside its body and it absorbs the food'; 'extracellular enzymes break down the orange, then it soaks up the nutrients'.
markingScheme.insufficient: 'It eats the orange' or 'it photosynthesises' (fungi have no chloroplasts). The word 'saprophytic' alone without the enzymes/absorption idea earns this mark only if the student also says it digests the food outside its body.

= the Explain question's 3-point marking scheme above, one-to-one. Do not award these marks a second time here.

levels.descriptor: None of the three analytic points achieved: no genuine scanner results quoted, and no correct explanation of what the flame or the virus lacks.

Any ONE of the three analytic points achieved: quotes two genuine Life-scanner results from their own record; OR explains the flame lacks real life processes (all-eight rule); OR explains the virus only reproduces inside a host cell / is not cellular.
Any TWO of the three analytic points achieved (own scanner results quoted; flame lacks all eight real processes; virus reproduces only inside a host / does nothing else on its own).

All three analytic points achieved: quotes at least two of their own Life-scanner results, explains what the flame is missing against the all-eight MRS C GREN rule, and explains that the virus only reproduces inside a host cell and does not carry out the other life processes.

criteria.source: = the Apply question's 3-point marking scheme above, one-to-one. Do not award these marks a second time here.

levels.descriptor: None of the three analytic points achieved: kingdom not identified as fungi, no structural feature, no description of how it feeds.

Any ONE of: names the kingdom as fungi; OR gives a fungal structural feature (hyphae/mycelium, chitin walls, many nuclei); OR explains saprophytic nutrition (enzymes released, digestion outside the body, absorption).
Any TWO of the three analytic points (fungi named; structural feature given; saprophytic nutrition explained).

All three analytic points: names fungi, gives a structural feature such as hyphae forming a mycelium or chitin walls, and explains that it secretes enzymes onto the orange, digests it outside its body and absorbs the products.

criteria.source: Assessed holistically across both the Explain and Apply answers together — independent of, and never overlapping with, the content marks above.

levels.descriptor: Too unclear or incomplete for the reasoning to be followed reliably; biology vocabulary missing or misused throughout.
Main meaning understandable, but organisation, precision or vocabulary has problems (e.g. 'breathing' used for respiration, kingdoms named vaguely).

Clear and logical in full sentences, using appropriate vocabulary precisely (e.g. life process, respiration, host cell, hyphae, chitin, enzymes, absorb). Minor spelling slips are not penalised unless they harm meaning.

markingInstructions: Mark ONLY the two constructed responses, using the point-by-point marking scheme carried in each question's marking context (award each point independently) and the rubric level descriptors, which restate the same three analytic points as bands — do not invent extra criteria. use_of_evidence equals the Explain marks and reasoning equals the Apply marks one-to-one; never award them twice. Communication (0-2) is holistic across both answers. Copy auto_marked_score into knowledge_accuracy. Accept scientifically valid alternative wording per each point's 'accept' field; do not penalise spelling unless meaning is unclear. For Explain point 1, check the quoted results against the raw Life-scanner rows in the Investigation Record. Report total, percentage, one strength, one correction, one next step, under 80 words.
